questions.question: What exact copyright notice should visitors see, including the wording, year, and rights-holder name?
questions.why: The ticket requires copyright text but does not identify its approved wording, year, or rights holder.

questions.question: Where should the approved static notice be defined?

options.label: B
options.text: Supply it from Django configuration or template context

questions.why: The ticket requests a one-off base-template change and the specification excludes administrative editing or persistence.
